hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *global-style-manager.php) h=$(grep -m1 "Version:" "$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE "[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+"); c=$(grep -m1 "GSM_VER" "$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE "[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+"); if [ -n "$h" ] && [ -n "$c" ] && [ "$h" != "$c" ]; then printf '{"systemMessage": "GSM version mismatch: Version header is %s but GSM_VER constant is %s -- update both together in global-style-manager.php."}' "$h" "$c"; fi ;; esac
